Action: # Article Bulk API: Bulk Article Create Status
## Bulk create reports which article has invalid metadata

Setup: Use the publisher_with_journal testdrive to set up for this test at /testdrive/publisher_with_journal. It creates a publisher account with an API key, owning a journal in DOAJ with Print ISSN "1111-1111" and E-ISSN "2222-2222"
Setup: If you have run this testdrive before, use the 'teardown' link from that earlier run first, so that no other journal has these ISSNs
Setup: Keep the testdrive tab open (closing it removes the test data) and do the test in a separate tab
Setup: At the end of the test please use the 'teardown' link provided by the testdrive to remove test assets from the system

Download the test resource file "bulk_api_articles_missing_title.json". It contains 3 articles; the second one has no title

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/4343_no_info_article_api/doajtest/example_files/bulk_api_articles_missing_title.json

Go to the API documentation page

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//api/docs

Open "POST /api/bulk/articles" (Bulk article creation (asynchronous)) and click "Try it out". Enter the api_key from the testdrive result, paste the whole contents of the downloaded file into the body, and click "Execute"

Expected Test Results: The response body contains an "upload_id" and a "status" link

Action: Open the "status" link from the response in a new tab. If the "status" is "pending" or "processing", wait a few seconds and reload until it changes

Expected Test Results: "error" is "Article at index 1: Field 'title' is required but not present at 'bibjson.'" (articles are counted from 0, so index 1 is the second article in the file)
There is no "results" section, because the batch was rejected before import

Action:
Go to the Table of Contents for the journal

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//toc/2222-2222

Expected Test Results: There are no articles whose title starts with "Bulk API test", because no articles are imported when any article in the batch fails
